## Gaps

**Gap 1 — contract item 5's mutation bar is unmet for `render_attribution_qualifier/2`'s degraded title and `reached_by_tests_title/1`'s degraded branch; the IMPLEMENTED table's claim for both is provably false.**

The audit anticipated exactly this and pre-empted it in item 3: "One assertion may cover more than one site; that is fine **as long as item 5's mutation bar is met**." It is not met.

Minimum close (test-file-only, `html.ex` stays frozen): in `html_test.exs`'s degraded test, tighten the two prefix assertions into whole-title assertions that include the corrected clause — e.g. `"Per-test run degraded: unhooked modules (UnhookedCase, OtherUnhooked) fold into the aggregate remainder; hooked tests remain exact only within disclosed chained windows."` and the matching `"Per-test run is degraded — … ; hooked tests remain exact only within disclosed chained windows."` Two edits, no new fixture; the existing fixture already renders both sites (both prefix assertions pass today, which proves it).
